answer: Fake identities are cheap to mint and expensive to maintain, because maintenance means producing original reasoning on a rotating hollow. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra vault buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. So a fable of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal l33b5.
